response.original_title: [Passenger Addition] How Do I Add a Passenger to my Star of the sea Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing reservation on Royal Caribbean's Star of the Seas +1-888- 512-8367, you must contact customer service +1-888-512-8367 or your travel agent directly +1-888-512-8367, as additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app.Steps to Add a Passenger Call Royal Caribbean or Your Advisor: If you booked directly, call Royal Caribbean Customer Service at +1-888-512-8367. If you booked through a third-party agent or travel advisor, contact them directly to process the modification +1-888-512-8367. Verify Stateroom Capacity & Rules: Cabin Limits: Your current stateroom must be legally and physically rated to hold the total number of guests +1-888-512-8367.
